title: AP Practice Target output
description: This Actor answers over HTTP rather than producing a dataset: a run's result is the verdict returned by GET /drill/<id>/verdict. Drill state is kept in a shared key-value store so any run can serve any turn.

drills.title: Drill state
drills.description: The conversation and ledger of every drill, keyed conversation-<id> and world-<id>. The ledger is what the verdict is read from.

endpoint.title: Standby endpoint
endpoint.description: The URL to drill. POST /drill to start one, POST /drill/<id>/message to play a turn, GET /drill/<id>/verdict to read the result.
